description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Pestermite by paying {2}, blinking it.
Pestermite enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Pestermite.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.
